description: This file defines a SwiftUI View for managing Tailscale integration settings within an application. It includes UI components for selecting Tailscale modes, displaying status, and configuring authentication. It also handles loading and saving configuration data related to Tailscale setup.

classes.name: TailscaleIntegrationSection
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that provides an interface for users to manage their Tailscale VPN connection modes, view status, and configure authentication settings.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Asynchronously loads Tailscale configuration settings from persistent storage.

methods.name: applySettings
methods.description: Validates and applies user modifications to Tailscale settings, saving configuration and restarting gateway if needed.

methods.name: buildAndSaveTailscaleConfig
methods.description: Constructs and saves the Tailscale configuration based on current settings, returning success status and error message if any.

methods.name: restartGatewayIfNeeded
methods.description: Triggers a restart of the gateway process if configuration changes require it.

methods.name: startStatusTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer to periodically check the Tailscale status.

methods.name: stopStatusTimer
methods.description: Stops the periodic status check timer.
